items.title: Introduction to Python's unittest and pytest modules (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Introduction to Python's unittest and pytest modules (PDF 65, printed 61), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: unittest module Python mein built-in hai aur test cases banane ka framework (dhaancha) deta hai. pytest bahar ka (external) module hai (pip install pytest se install hota hai) jo tests likhna aur chalana aasan banata hai. Dono jaanchte hain ke code tawaqqo ke mutabiq chalta hai. Yeh akele functions, classes ya poore modules test kar sakte hain. In tools se program mazboot hota hai aur bari applications mein ghaltiyan kam hoti hain.

blocks.caption: unittest aur pytest ka muqabla
rows: External: pip install pytest se lagta hai
